title: Certificate Characterization of Non-Tautologies
statement: For every binary string $x$, $x$ lies outside the language of tautologies if and only if there is a binary word $u$ of length exactly $|x|+1$ such that the DNF decoded from $x$ evaluates to false under the assignment that reads variable $v$ from the $v$-th bit of $u$ and assigns false when $v\ge |u|$.
replaced:
For every binary string $x$, $x$ lies outside $\mathrm{TAUTOLOGY}$ if and only if
there exists a binary word $u$ of length exactly $|x| + 1$ such that the DNF decoded
from $x$ evaluates to false under the assignment $\alpha_u$ that reads variable $v$
off the $v$-th bit of $u$ (false for $v \ge |u|$).
